sketches.mechanism: An empty data declaration creates an uninhabited type, and EmptyCase lets a case expression over it be exhaustive with no branches.
sketches.resonance: Only the impossible absence can be transformed into anything at all.

sketches.mechanism: The equals sign is pattern matching, and a variable already bound by one match cannot be rebound to a different value.
sketches.resonance: A vow may be repeated, but the moment it becomes another thing the world refuses to continue.

sketches.mechanism: Lua treats only false and nil as falsey; numeric zero is truthy in conditionals.
sketches.resonance: Even zero is allowed to stand up and be counted as present.
sketches.draft:
local absence = 0
if absence then
  return absence
end
